subject: [PATCH v4 03/19] selftests/mm: scale khugepaged's collapse wait with the PMD size

reviews.author: Lorenzo Stoakes (ARM)
reviews.summary: Acknowledged the patch as reasonable, but expressed concern that it makes selftests run slowly on small page size machines and asked if there's a way to trim the wait time.

2026-08-15.patch_summary: The patch adjusts the wait time for khugepaged's collapse operation based on the PMD size, ensuring that large page sizes don't cause excessive delays in selftests.
